effects_plain.Brutal: monsters: + flat Pierce damage (level-indexed array) and +50% Pierce damage
effects_plain.Leeching: monsters: offensiveLifeLeechMin 600 = 600% of attack damage returned as health (wiki: "attack damage converted to health")
effects_plain.Cruel: monsters: each hit reduces the target's (player's) total damage by 8% for 1 s
effects_plain.Corrupted: monsters: + flat Chaos damage (level-indexed array) and +50% Chaos damage
effects_plain.Resilient: player: +8% Poison and +8% Bleeding resistance, +8% max Poison and max Bleeding resistance

cross_check_FOOTAGE: No life-multiplier mutator is active: Toughened (+12% life) and Regenerating (+6% life) would move every monster max-HP fingerprint; 105 of 118 recurring fingerprints match the Lap D no-mutator eHP exactly. Consistent with the identified six.
The wiki text for some mutators is out of date versus Ed IV records (e.g. wiki Brutal = crit/OA); the effects above are the Ed IV records, verbatim.
oracle_notes_INFERRED: Leeching (600% of attack damage healed) acts on monster sustain: it lengthens time-to-kill against the player's damage, not player intake directly.
Cruel (-8% player damage for 1 s per monster hit) lowers player kill rate under crowding; it compounds with crowd density.
Brutal and Corrupted add flat + 50% pierce/chaos to every monster attack: direct intake increase; magnitude depends on the per-attack flat terms and the player's pierce/chaos resists.
Ascended +8% player damage partly offsets Cruel; Resilient matters only against bleed/poison sources.
The pack/oracle has NO mutator layer today (KP-211: "mutators NOT run", estimated +10-30%).
